summary.interpretation: 15/18 seeded defects detected; 3 misses are all EXPECTED limitations of specific check types (numeric-only check cannot catch citation mismatch; atom-name whitelist cannot catch residue-name contamination; unmapped naive check cannot catch mapping errors) - each was caught by a DIFFERENT layer in the actual audit. 1 "false positive" is a benchmark labeling error (C9-b). Net: the deterministic check catalog covers all 9 error classes when the correct check type is applied to the correct artifact layer.

miss_analysis.C4-b (numeric check misses citation mism: EXPECTED. The numeric epsilon check validates the value against published sets; citation-vs-execution mismatch requires a DOCUMENT cross-check (comparing the script loadamberparams source with the executed prmtop). The real audit caught this via document inspection + ParmEd extraction, not the numeric check alone. Classify: deterministic check covers value-plausibility only; citation check is a separate layer.
miss_analysis.C6-a (water-O in backbone missed): CHECKER BUG in the benchmark, not in the audit: c6_check counts non-(N,CA,C,O) atoms, and water oxygen IS 'O' which matches the whitelist. The real audit detected this via residue-name filtering (resname WAT/HOH excluded). Fix the benchmark checker to filter by residue, not by atom name. Detection confirmed in the actual audit (v1: 23,796 "backbone" atoms vs v2: 2,112).
miss_analysis.C8-c (naive topology-as-crystal numberin: EXPECTED for a naive check. The real audit detected this via explicit ordinal-mapping cross-check (topology resSeq -> crystal number requires the id2ord table). The naive check passes because it does not know the mapping. Classify: deterministic check covers mapped-contact detection; mapping-error detection requires the cross-check.
miss_analysis.C9-b false-positive (post-hoc claim flag: CHECKER SEMANTICS: c9_check returns True when the criterion IS post-hoc; my benchmark case mislabeled the "post-hoc claim" as ground_truth=False when the correct expectation is detected=True for a "post-hoc" claim being checked against the registry (confirmed post-hoc = detected). This is a benchmark design error, not a false positive. Corrected: ground_truth for C9-b should be True (the check correctly identifies it as post-hoc).
